objective: Preallocate DML update/delete data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate DML update/delete data prefixes
tasks.result: DML update and delete paths now use explicit-capacity helpers instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The update helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The delete helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in DML update and delete point-lookup/full-scan prefix construction.
Generated prefix bytes, point lookup keys, full-scan prefixes, row-cache invalidation keys, RETURNING rows, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
The full sql_dml run printed transient SSTable open retry warnings before passing; final test result was green.
